baseline_models.focus_anchor: The selective question bi-ayyi joins the focus noun at word 2 to the dual Lord-title and the Form II verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal, lordly ownership and nurture, and an act of declaring false combine into an itemizing challenge: the two addressees must identify which concrete provision they can responsibly pronounce unreal.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies bestowed favors as the objects placed under examination.
The branch supplies ownership and authority, making the giver personally answerable in the question.
The branch adds staged nurture and completion, so the favors are administered processes as well as objects.
The branch supplies the act of assigning falsehood, turning the dual response into a verdict on what was given.

changed_reading.before: A general rhetorical rebuke for ingratitude.
changed_reading.after: An item-by-item demand that two recipients name which administered gift they can actually adjudge false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb تُكَذِّبَانِ governs the Lord's favors rather than merely describing a private opinion.
baseline_models.mechanism: A charge can prove true by being carried through or false by failing. Joined to nurture and bestowal, this makes denial performative: recipients belie a favor when they fail to enact the capacity or obligation it brought into being.

activation_trace.role: The bestowed-favor branch provides what the recipients have received and can either realize or waste.
The repair-and-completion branch makes lordly giving an enabling formation that calls for continuation.
The branch's fulfilled-or-failed charge supplies the test by which conduct can make a received favor appear false.

changed_reading.before: To belie is chiefly to reject a true statement.
changed_reading.after: To belie can also be to make a Lord-given capacity fail in performance, converting recognition into an enacted test.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes ءَالَاءِ, رَبِّكُمَا, and تُكَذِّبَانِ in a direct second-person interrogation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath branch under the focus noun and the pact branch under Rabb create a covenantal undertone. On this branch-distant reading, the question cross-examines the two parties about which pledged bond under their Lord they will treat as void or false.

activation_trace.role: The oath-making branch gives the questioned noun a possible undertone of solemn commitment.
The covenant-and-protection branch supplies a binding relation governed by the Lord-title.
The declaring-false branch turns breach into an explicit repudiation of the pledged relation.

changed_reading.after: The benefits also carry a speculative covenantal claim: which binding Lord-recipient relation will the pair repudiate?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant mapping attached to the focus word ءَالَاءِ offers following and answering-voice images inside a question addressed to two speakers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can be heard not only as content but as a response-shaped utterance: one voice follows another and demands a dual counter-answer. This is form-distant at baseline but remains anchored in the focus token and interrogative construction.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch supplies following in sequence as a possible formal property of the utterance.
The answering-voice branch supplies an antiphonal relation in which this question can answer a preceding voice and solicit another.
The declaring-false branch defines the answer whose repeated solicitation gives the voice its adversarial edge.

changed_reading.after: A possible answering voice that follows prior speech and opens a response slot for the two addressees.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves from mercy through teaching and recitation to human articulation. The favors questioned at 55:65 therefore become deliberately disclosed signs, and denial becomes refusal of recognition after a merciful pedagogy rather than ignorance before evidence.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the favors that the opening pedagogy renders recognizable.
The focus branch supplies the adverse verdict now issued despite prior disclosure.
Mercy and tenderness make the ensuing disclosure beneficent rather than merely prosecutorial.
Uncovering something to a knower supplies the transition from latent gift to recognized evidence.
Reading and recitation supply the voiced medium through which recognition is taught.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign makes denial a response to manifest communication.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 orders mercy, teaching, creation, and articulation before the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered opening and disclosure branches; I infer that the order makes pedagogy the route from favor to accountable recognition. An enumerative rather than causal opening remains possible, but it still leaves the favors presented as knowable signs.

changed_reading.after: Which mercifully taught and articulated signs will you still pronounce false after they have been made knowable?

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculated cosmic order becomes an imperative to maintain just weight and not short-change the scale. That sequence activates the performed-truth and covenantal baselines: recipients can belie lordly favor by making its measured order fail in their own dealings.

activation_trace.role: The focus pact branch supplies the binding frame in which measured conduct becomes fidelity.
The focus branch supplies a charge that becomes false when its bearers fail to carry it through.
Counting and calculation make order exact enough to test rather than vaguely admire.
The just-balance branch transfers cosmic proportion into a norm for action.
Justice and equity specify the faithful human realization of the balance.
Short-changing measure supplies the concrete way recipients can falsify an entrusted order.

structural_cues: 55:5-9 moves from calculated celestial motion to prohibitions and commands addressed to human measurers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, balance, equity, and short measure; I infer an arrow from received cosmic order to obligated social enactment. The live alternative is that the two domains are parallel illustrations rather than a delegated charge.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an incorrect claim about divine gifts.
changed_reading.after: Denial also occurs when recipients distort the measure that a lordly gift entrusted them to maintain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Thirty non-focus recurrences make the non-dominant following and answering-voice branches materially live. The focus question is one station in a patterned exchange: each exhibit speaks, the refrain answers it, and the dual verb leaves the two recipients a recurring reply slot.

activation_trace.role: At the focus, the answering-voice branch anchors the refrain as a responsive utterance.
The first recurrence supplies one utterance following the preceding exhibit in sequence.
The nearby recurrence supplies an answering voice that prepares the same formal role at 55:65.
The repeated demand to declare false gives the antiphonal response its stable contested content.

structural_cues: The exact focus sentence recurs thirty times outside 55:65 and repeatedly follows short descriptive units.
At 55:65 it answers the one-word dual description in 55:64 and precedes another dual description in 55:66.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence plus sequence and answering-voice branches; I infer that refrain position functions like responsive speech. It may instead be a one-sided litany with no implied audible reply, but the dual verb still repeatedly solicits one.

changed_reading.before: An isolated rhetorical question about a preceding gift.
changed_reading.after: A recurring counter-voice in which each displayed sign is followed by a renewed demand for the pair's answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dual grammar is echoed by human and hidden-being addressees, meeting seas, a maintained between-space, non-transgression, and joined pairs. The question thus tests whether the pair can recognize relation without collapsing distinction: favor includes both connection and a boundary that prevents one side from consuming the other.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch makes the dual addressees jointly responsible for a verdict about bounded relations.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies contact without prior identity.
A linkage standing between endpoints makes the boundary relational rather than mere separation.
Transgressing a limit supplies the failure that the maintained relation prevents.
The hidden beings identify one member of the repeatedly addressed pair.
Manifest humanity contrasted with wildness and hidden beings identifies the other member of the pair.
One counterpart joined to another generalizes paired complementarity inside the garden catalogue.

structural_cues: Dual forms recur across addressees, horizons, seas, gardens, springs, and fruit pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired entities, contact, a between-relation, and non-transgression; I infer that these relations train the two addressees in recognizing difference-with-connection. The simpler alternative is that the dual pronouns merely name two species while the other pairs are independent ornaments.

changed_reading.before: Two recipients are jointly asked about an undifferentiated list of gifts.
changed_reading.after: Two distinct recipients are tested by a world of paired relations whose connection and limits are themselves favors.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit contrast between passing-away and remaining, followed later by continuous provision, activates the focus verb's image of a supply that disappoints by not lasting. The question can therefore resist a category error: a finite form's ending does not prove that lordly favor failed, because giver, remainder, and renewed provision occupy different temporal scales.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the material image of expected provision disappearing and thereby seeming to fail.
The focus branch supplies staying and duration on the giver's side of the contrast.
Passing away after a period of persistence supplies the real finitude that could be mistaken for failed giving.
Endurance supplies the contrasting temporal register attributed to the Lord.
Continuing provision supplies renewal rather than permanence of each individual form.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 places universal passing-away directly against the Lord's remaining face, while later garden units repeatedly renew provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finitude, endurance, and continuous giving; I infer that recipients may falsely equate an individual gift's ending with failure of favor itself. The live alternative is that the mortality contrast is ontological only and does not activate the focus verb's supply idiom.

changed_reading.before: A favor is credible only if its present form lasts.
changed_reading.after: Do not call favor false when a finite form passes; continuity may lie in the enduring giver, remainder, and renewed provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The maxim that good action is met by good action gives the refrain a reciprocal mechanism. The appropriate answer to favor is not verbal assent alone but a corresponding act; failure to return good makes the received good untrue in the recipient's conduct.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the initiating favor to which a response is due.
The focus charge branch lets response prove true through completion or false through failure.
Matching an action with its recompense supplies the return movement.
Good action on both sides identifies enactment, not mere appreciation, as the fitting response.

structural_cues: 55:60 states a mirrored action-response formula, and 55:61 immediately answers it with the same refrain later heard at 55:65.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal recompense and repeated good action; I infer that this reciprocity specifies how favor is truthfully answered. The alternative is a reward statement confined to the garden section, though its placement beside the refrain keeps the response relation active.

changed_reading.before: Acknowledging favor is primarily a correct verbal judgment.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledging favor requires a reciprocal good act that carries the gift's claim into conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second garden pair is introduced by a term that can suggest being below the goal or lowly, yet it remains tree-concealed, water-rich, and fruitful. The unchanged refrain at 55:65 blocks comparative erasure: relative lowness or secondness does not make a provision no favor.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch keeps the second garden pair inside the category of bestowed favor.
The focus branch makes devaluation a verdict that the repeated question contests.
The lowliness branch supplies the comparative devaluation that could make the second pair seem negligible.
A garden concealed by trees supplies substantial life even where rank or visibility seems lower.
Abundantly gushing water demonstrates that the allegedly lower pair is not depleted.
Pleasant fruit supplies realized yield after the contested comparison.

structural_cues: A first pair of gardens appears at 55:46 and a second pair at 55:62; the same refrain assigns both sections full interrogative weight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparative lowness plus concealed garden, gushing water, and fruit; I infer that identical refrains resist treating lower rank as null value. A genuine hierarchy may remain, but hierarchy and denial of favor are not the same judgment.

changed_reading.before: The refrain generically labels every garden feature a blessing.
changed_reading.after: Will the pair deny a real favor merely because it is second, nearer, lower, or comparatively less exalted?

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between black-dark appearance and abundant gushing, while a later green branch explicitly includes green so intense that it blackens. Activated by the focus verb's deceptive-surface image, the refrain corrects perception: opacity or darkness can be the visible compression of dense life rather than evidence of deprivation.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies an appearance that misreports its own condition, making visual misclassification part of denial.
The focus branch requires the dark-looking feature to be tested as favor rather than dismissed by appearance.
Dark blackness supplies the initially ambiguous surface immediately before the focus.
Abundant gushing water reveals plenitude immediately behind the dark surface.
Green that blackens through intensity supplies the lexical bridge from darkness to vegetative density.

structural_cues: The focus is exactly bracketed by the one-word dark dual at 55:64 and the gushing dual springs at 55:66.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dark blackness, abundant water, and intense green that can blacken; I infer that density and watering explain the dark appearance and that the refrain corrects a surface judgment. Darkness and gushing could instead be independent listed features, so the causal arrow remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: The question simply appends a blessing-label to dark-green gardens.
changed_reading.after: The question challenges the eye: will you call the dark surface false or deficient when it may be the very mark of saturated life?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates an idiom of an animal running and then stopping, not the dominant denial sense. It remains anchored directly in تُكَذِّبَانِ and gains formal support from recurrent interruptions of flowing description; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic word-image, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 4 occupies a refrain that repeatedly interrupts the surah's forward descriptive motion.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies running for a stage and stopping to look behind as the refrain's kinetic image.
Literal flowing supplies forward motion within a garden unit that the next refrain arrests.
The nearby identical verb supplies a prior stop-and-look station before 55:65 repeats the maneuver.
Following in sequence makes the stops recurrent rather than a single accidental pause.

changed_reading.before: The refrain halts the catalogue only for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The refrain may enact a stop-and-look discipline, arresting forward appetite so the pair reviews what just passed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the plant-name branch attached to ءَالَاءِ, whose beautiful appearance and bitter taste are not the noun's dominant sense. The exact focus token, the deceptive-surface branch of its verb, and the nearby dark garden and fruit keep the contrast anchored; prose should label it a homonymic sensory echo rather than claim that ālāʾ means this shrub here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 2 and verb at word 4 can jointly stage a mismatch between attractive appearance and experienced taste.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies a plant that looks beautiful yet tastes bitter, preserving mixed valuation inside the questioned gift.
The focus branch supplies an appearance capable of deceiving, linking visual attraction to possible misjudgment.
The immediately preceding black-dark surface makes appearance an unstable guide to value.
Pleasant fruit supplies the contrasting taste-value within the same local garden sequence.

changed_reading.before: A favor must be immediately and uniformly pleasant to count as true favor.
changed_reading.after: A mixed gift may join beauty, darkness, sweetness, or bitterness; denying it can begin by demanding that value have only one sensory face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples two dairy-adjacent focus branches with water and provision branches elsewhere. It remains anchored in رَبِّكُمَا and تُكَذِّبَانِ and forms a coherent material analogy of nurture that either continues or disappoints; downstream prose should call it an image-network, not a lexical gloss of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus Lord-title and denial verb carry branch images of fresh milk-bearing nurture and a supply that fails to last.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies fresh post-birth nurture and an animal retained for milk.
The focus branch supplies milk that disappears before expected, materializing an accusation that provision has failed.
Continuing provision supplies a broader answer to the fear of interrupted nurture.
Water gushing in abundance gives the local, immediately post-focus image of supply that does not peter out.
Stable, growing good closes the surah with persistence rather than failed provision.

changed_reading.before: The pair denies a proposition about favors.
changed_reading.after: At the level of material analogy, the pair accuses its nurturer's supply of drying up even as flowing, gushing, and stable increase answer that fear.

strongest_changes: The refrain became a mercifully taught recognition checkpoint rather than a bare rebuke.
Balance and reciprocity expanded denial from false speech into failed enactment of an entrusted order.
Exact recurrence activated a cautious antiphonal reading in which the refrain answers each exhibit and solicits the pair's reply.
At 55:65 specifically, comparative lowness and black-looking surface were re-read through concealed garden, gushing water, and green intense enough to blacken.
summary.what_was_special: The non-dominant following/answering mapping made the repeated sentence audible as a sequence, while the focus verb's material branches exposed three live alternatives: conduct that fails a charge, motion arrested to look back, and appearance or supply that disappoints expectation. These coexist with, rather than replace, the strong favor-and-verdict reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ت ل و activations may be formal echoes produced by a split mapping rather than semantic pressure available in ordinary hearing.
The arrow from intense greenness and gushing water to the dark surface is abductive even though the later green branch explicitly permits blackening by intensity.
دُون may mark spatial relation, otherness, or genuine rank; the retained reading claims only that relative rank does not erase favor.
The dairy, plant, cloth, and stop-and-look branches should remain qualified image-networks, not replacement glosses.
